prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent hero illustration for an academic researcher's website, beside the headline at 300px wide.
Primary request: Create a scholarly research atlas still life, with a subtle hand-painted RPG inventory-art feeling. A navy leather open research notebook with warm parchment pages and brass corners sits beneath a small elegant brass armillary geometric model: connected navy nodes on thin gold orbital rings, suggesting geometric deep learning and scientific discovery. A short navy pencil rests along the notebook. One coherent compact object group, three-quarter isometric view. The notebook page has only a spare triangle-and-nodes sketch, no text or equations. The supplied image is a STYLE REFERENCE only: match its painterly edges, navy/gold/parchment materials and restrained academic mood; create a NEW composition with the armillary model as the focal point.
Composition: centered, roughly square, all objects fully visible, tight usable framing with 6% transparent margins; silhouette clean and readable at 300px. No background rectangle, landscape, desk surface, frame, checkerboard, glow or haze; genuinely transparent empty space around objects. Crisp alpha edges; soft local contact shadows only beneath the objects, no dark outer halo. No people, fantasy weapons, magic, lettering, logos or watermark.
